apply_quant_noise_linear: apply quantization noise to a PyTorch Linear module with a specified noise probability and block size
apply_quant_noise_embedding: apply quantization noise to a PyTorch Embedding module for subsequent Iterative Product Quantization
apply_quant_noise_conv2d: apply quantization noise to a PyTorch Conv2d module with configurable block size and noise rate
review_quant_noise_hook: review the quant_noise function and its forward pre hook that randomly drops weight blocks during training
test_quant_noise_block_sizes: test the quant_noise function to verify block size assertions for Linear, Embedding, and Conv2d modules
